video_title: Kawhi trade to Raptors could be CANCELED if NBA investigation continues 👀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Baxter Holmes
quotes.summary_phrase: Investigation into Clippers and Kawhi Leonard could extend into 2027
quotes.excerpt: It could go well into 2027. And part of that is because the collective bargaining agreement
quotes.quote: It could go well into 2027. And part of that is because the collective bargaining agreement basically lays out the process for this, which could include arbitration. It could also include an appeals panel. There are several different parties that are coming to the table. It is not as simple as the NBA basically finding evidence and rendering punishment or not. There are a lot of different steps that have to play out from now until then. Different sources I have talked to have said, given all those steps, they have a hard time seeing a full resolution being reached before the start of the season.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Possibility of Kawhi Leonard remaining with Clippers for the season
quotes.excerpt: Does that open up the possibility that Kawhi Leonard could be on the Clippers to start the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: Does that open up the possibility that Kawhi Leonard could be on the Clippers to start the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Baxter Holmes
text_blocks.text: Yes. I mean, it sounds crazy after a trade like this, but this was the Toronto Raptors being given a choice of, are you willing to assume the risks of something happening with Kawhi Leonard after the investigation is completed? And they are not willing to assume those risks.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins believes Toronto Raptors should back out of trade
quotes.excerpt: If I am the Toronto Raptors, I am finding a way to get up out of this deal.
quotes.quote: If I am the Toronto Raptors, I am finding a way to get up out of this deal. I am finding a way to back out. I want out. I do not want to even be involved with this no more. I do not even want to think about having Kawhi Leonard in a uniform because now, all of a sudden, say if this lingers on and it gets closer to the season. We are talking about real human beings here. We are talking about Brandon Ingram and Gradey Dick, who was a crucial part of the Raptors success last year for us them being relevant again and making it to the postseason. If I am the Raptors, I want to call this trade off.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors monitoring Kawhi Leonard trade situation
quotes.excerpt: If I am Golden State, I am actually hoping this deal does get called off
quotes.quote: If I am Golden State, I am actually hoping this deal does get called off and I get to monitor this situation because if Kawhi Leonard goes back to the Clippers, if I am Golden State, then I am picking up the phone and I am seeing what is up with Kawhi Leonard because Golden State does not have time to waste. Steph Curry is 39 years old. Steph Curry played at an All-NBA level last year when he was available. Steph Curry needs another dude on the side of him. We do not know what Jimmy Butler is going to look like.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns expects resolution on contract extension soon
quotes.excerpt: He wants to be a Knick for life. He is expecting some resolution to that soon.
quotes.quote: Go back to during the season when Karl-Anthony Towns wanted an extension from the Knicks. The Knicks did not offer him one. He was disappointed, but he says he wants to be a Knick for life. He said, these are the things that handle itself in the off-season as long as I handle myself on the floor. The Knicks won a championship, Karl-Anthony Towns was a hub. He is expecting some resolution to that soon.

quotes.speaker: Marc Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart believes Jalen Duren deserves a new contract
quotes.excerpt: Isaiah really feels like he proved that he deserved a contract. He made an All-Star
quotes.quote: Isaiah really feels like he proved that he deserved a contract. He made an All-Star and I think a lot of times teams should not look so much as the postseason. You got to look at the whole body of work and Isaiah says that Jalen believes he proved no matter what happened in the playoffs that he is deserving of this money.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden negotiating new contract with Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: The Cavaliers are still poking around with Peyton Watson and I think that is why James
quotes.quote: I think that could happen relatively soon. The question is going to be is it a two-year deal, a three-year deal with the structure likely is going to determine what the money looks like. But the Cavaliers are still poking around with Peyton Watson and I think that is why James is given them a lot of room to negotiate.
